title: At the pharmacy
instructions: Sara eczanede ilaç alıyor. Kısa bir diyalog; ilacın nasıl kullanılacağına dikkat et.

script.speaker: sara
script.text: Hello. I have a sore throat. Can you give me something for it?

script.speaker: chemist
script.text: Sure. Take one of these sweets every four hours.

script.speaker: sara
script.text: Can I take them with food?

script.speaker: chemist
script.text: Yes, that's fine. If you don't feel better in three days, see a doctor.

script.speaker: sara
script.text: Thank you. How much are they?

questions.prompt: How often should she take the medicine?
questions.feedback: Her dört saatte bir (every four hours) bir tane.
questions.evidence: Take one of these sweets every four hours.

questions.prompt: When should Sara see a doctor?
options: if she doesn't feel better in three days
questions.feedback: Üç gün içinde iyileşmezse doktora gitmeli.
questions.evidence: If you don't feel better in three days, see a doctor.

questions.prompt: How much does the medicine cost?
questions.feedback: İlaç dört pound yirmi (four pounds twenty).
